::: {#def-level-order}
#### Level order

Let $B$ be a binary tree (@def-binary-tree) that is not empty, and let $T$ be its drawing (@rem-binary-drawing), with root $r$.
Give $T$ the adjacency list (@def-adjacency-list) in which the list of each vertex $v$ is
its parent (@def-tree-parent), if $v$ has one,
then the root of its left subtree and the root of its right subtree, if these subtrees are not empty.
The **level order** of $B$ [@wikipedia_tree_traversal] is the order in which `bfs(T, r)` (@def-bfs) removes the vertices of $T$ from its queue (@def-queue).

:::
